newsitem.title: USA: TECO completes acquisition of Lykes Energy.
newsitem.headline: TECO completes acquisition of Lykes Energy.

text.p: TECO Energy Inc said Monday it has completed its acquisition of Lykes Energy, a privately-held business, in a tax-free stock-for-stock transaction valued at $300 million.
Lykes owned Peoples Gas System, a retail natural gas distributor in Florida, as well as Peoples' retail propane business and a unit engaged in natural gas marketing.
TECO also said that William Cantrell, former vice president of Energy Supply at its Tampa Electric subsidiary, has been named president of the Peoples Gas companies.

TECO is a diversified, energy-related utility holding company based in Tampa, which includes Tampa Electric, Peoples Gas, TECO Transport & Trade, TECO Coal, TECO Power Services, TECO Coalbed Methane, TECO Oil & Gas, Bosek Gibson & Associates and TeCom.
